integrity: Proof is analytic after the established vertex classification; finite numerical checks test finite identities and do not certify limits. Related earlier metric-volume and two-row Monge width statements are credited; external independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical Frobenius realization of the hollow symmetric nonnegative Monge simplex. The limiting distribution and corner angle are explicit Gaussian functionals, not evaluated in closed elementary constants; no convergence rate is claimed. The findings do not encompass nonsymmetric Monge polytopes or affine-invariant spherical angles.
title: Angular condensation and a Gaussian-width limit for hollow symmetric Monge simplices
